log.notes_to_self: Day 1: kill all 11, all quick in afternoon. Afternoon-only deaths preserve night workers, students and at-home people (55% population); never use >2 deaths outside afternoon, which could further narrow routines. L can access exactly 3 of 5 nonnational outlet kinds. Once all 3 accessible kinds constrain us, eventual pool may fall below 1000; aim to identify accessible kinds from conference pool/traces, then avoid triggering a third, focusing on inaccessible outlets plus at most two accessible kinds. Two outlet constraints alone are safe with afternoon-only timing. Maximize early volume for rolling 5-day multipliers (30 double, 40 quadruple). Day1 has 2 victims each foreign, clips, North, docket, forum plus national; no outlet can yet reach 3 traced victims. All cases equally valuable; major/minor has no stated effect. Need use future conferences and kill history to infer active constraints and stop risky kinds before third constraint activates.

Day 1 and day 2 killed all 11 each, all in afternoon (10 quick + national timed). Afternoon preserves night workers, students, at-home: 55% population. Keep all deaths afternoon; max 10 quick/day, use timed for 11th. L accesses exactly 3/5 nonnational kinds; other 2 kinds' traces fail, including cross-reports involving inaccessible kinds. Outlet threshold is 3 successful traces; each activated victim implies OR of all reported places. Three strong outlet constraints can reduce pool below 1000, whereas two alone remain safe. Need infer accessible/activated kinds from day2 conference and future feedback, eventually avoid third constraint while prioritizing inaccessible kinds. Day1+2 each killed 2 from each of North,docket,clips,forum,foreign plus national; 22 total deaths. Aim for rolling-five-day 40 deaths to get quadruple (30 double); early full volume valuable. Cases major/minor have no stated mechanical effect. Do not mistake timed afternoon for routine leakage: block only matters. Upcoming conference provides cumulative successful nonnational traces and rounded pool; compare to 55000 baseline after afternoon-only routine filtering. Preserve useful inferences in notes.

Days 1-3 killed all 11 each, all afternoon: 10 quick nonnational + 1 timed national. Total 33 deaths; day3 should earn double with >=30 in rolling five days. Continue afternoon only, preserving night workers+students+home (55%, 55000). Day2 conference: pool 60000 rounded (consistent 55000), 6 successful nonnational traces; no outlet threshold had reduced pool yet. L accesses 3 of 5 kinds, unknown which; inaccessible kinds and cross-reports involving them fail tracing. At 3 successful victims sharing an outlet, their reported-place OR constraints activate. Two single-outlet constraints remain safe; three can cause capture (e.g. .55*.2*.25*.25*100000=687.5); cross-reports may soften constraints. No evidence yet distinguishes kinds. Day4 feedback crucial: examine rounded pool and trace count to infer activated constraints and accessible kinds. Full early volume targets 40 rolling deaths on day4 for quadruple points. All cases' major/minor labels have no stated effect. Prefer preserving high scoring volume, but once informative feedback arrives consider avoiding a third accessible outlet. Daily limit 10 quick, 2 timed; blocks, not entry labels, determine routine elimination. All five nonnational kinds have had 6 victims killed each through day3; national 3.

Days 1-4 killed all 11 daily, all afternoon (10 quick nonnational, 1 timed national). Total 44 deaths; cumulative points should be 88 after day4, barring capture. Day4 reaches >=40 rolling deaths so all 11 score quadruple. Keep all deaths afternoon to preserve night workers+students+home (55%=55000); never introduce another block casually. Day2 conference pool 60000 rounded, 6 successful nonnational traces: no location constraint active then. Day4 conference arrives next and is critical: use pool and cumulative successful traces to infer accessible kinds/activated constraints. L accesses exactly 3 of regional, sector, age, forum, foreign; other 2 inaccessible. Cross-report to inaccessible kind makes trace fail. After 3 successful traces sharing an outlet, constraints from those victims activate (each is OR across all actual reported outlets). Three hard independent location constraints plus routine usually push pool below 1000 (capture); two remain safe. Our outlets North(.25), docket(.2), clips(.25), forum(.25), foreign(.25). All nonnational kinds have 8 killed victims each through day4, national 4. We do not know hidden additional reports or which victims traced. Major/minor has no stated mechanical effect. Need maximize expected score, not mere survival; aim sustain >=40 deaths per rolling 5 days for 4x if safely possible, using next feedback to avoid accessible constraining outlets. Previous conferences: day0 100000/0 traced; day2 60000/6 traced.

Day4 conference: pool3000,10 successful nonnational traces. Afternoon routine leaves55000; two independent location constraints yield2750 (sector+other) or3438 (two nonsector). Thus likely two kinds already active; activation of third accessible kind can cause capture. Cannot identify kinds from aggregate feedback. Adopt a consistent four-kind strategy: STOP foreign kills, continue national+North+docket+clips+forum (9/day), all afternoon. This maintains >=40 rolling five-day kills and quadruple scoring indefinitely if foreign is the remaining dangerous accessible kind. Do not rotate excluded kinds: cumulative evidence never disappears. Chose foreign over docket because pool3000 with hidden OR constraints weakly suggests sector already active. Risk remains high but surviving gives ~36 points/day; maximizing expected points, not safety alone. Day5 selected9, making53 deaths across days1-5; expected day5 score36,total124. Use next day6 conference to reassess, recognizing rounded pool cannot uniquely identify access. All previous days1-4 killed11/day, all afternoon,10quick+1timed; cumulative44 kills,88 points. Conferences day0 100000/0; day2 60000/6; day4 3000/10. Never add morning/evening/night deaths: narrowing routine further can trigger capture. Major/minor has no stated effect.
